changes.comment: The Dispatcher Agent has its own Commands. `dispatcher.submit` submits one turn to the addressed Dispatcher's own Agent and `dispatcher.interrupt` interrupts it; both address that Dispatcher through the caller context, like every other Command in the namespace, and both are reachable over `admin.sock` and a Channel's in-process port. `team.submit` and `team.interrupt` now require `team_name`: a Team Command names exactly one Team, and a call that omits the name is answered `BAD_REQUEST` by schema validation before any Agent is reached, instead of silently reaching the Dispatcher Agent. A caller that relied on the omission calls the Dispatcher Command instead. The two submit Commands share one reader for the Channel-facing payload (`service/channel-submission.ts`), which owns the attribute, text, reminder, and `source_id` rules once and fixes the `channel` provenance for both, and `DispatcherService.interrupt(teamId | null)` splits into `interruptAgent()` and `interruptTeamLeader(teamId)` to match.
